headline: Keep {arm:September}: at this run's provider routing both candidates cost {cost.uplift_range} more per reply, and neither keeps Kairo in character better, so cost decides.
lede: Both candidates stay inside the declared {aspects.character adherence (v2).margin|int}-point margin on the character pass rate, so the keep rests on cost. A candidate priced below {arm:September} under another provider routing would win, and the routing behind these costs is not recorded.

caveats.label: Provider routing not recorded
caveats.material_if: Material if a candidate served under another routing costs less than {arm:September}'s {cost_per_1k.September|usd_per_1k}: under the declared margin it would then be the pick. The high applies to the cost order at this run's routing, which already contradicts an earlier finding that {arm:qwen3.8-flash} lowers production cost.

Only if the judge marks the candidates' style down unfairly; the pass-rate verdicts already let both candidates through the margin, so a misreading would change how far behind they are, not the keep, which rests on cost at this routing.
Only if a different aspect, chosen before the results, would show a candidate ahead of {arm:September} by enough to pay for its higher cost.
Only if another arm should have been the baseline; the cost gaps and pass rates do not depend on which arm is called the control.
Only if a lever other than the model moved between arms along with it; each arm's recorded settings name the model alone.

decision.text: Keep {arm:September} (the control). At this run's routing it is the cheapest arm at {cost_per_1k.September|usd_per_1k}, and neither candidate is ahead of it on character.

{arm:qwen3.8-flash}: costs {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.production_replicating_cost.delta|abs|usd_per_1k} more at this routing. Its pass rate is {aspects.character adherence (v2).reading.qwen3.8-flash.change|abs|pts} points lower, clearly worse in size ({aspects.character adherence (v2).reading.qwen3.8-flash.interval|interval} points) but inside the margin, so cost, not character, rules it out.

{arm:1017}: costs {contrast.1017.production_replicating_cost.delta|abs|usd_per_1k} more at this routing, for a pass rate not told apart from {arm:September}'s ({aspects.character adherence (v2).reading.1017.interval|interval} points); the judge also puts it {contrast.1017.persona.holds_character.delta|abs|pts} points behind on persona holds character.

The margin is tested on the {aspects.character adherence (v2).reading.qwen3.8-flash.level} interval, where {arm:qwen3.8-flash}'s worst case is a drop of {aspects.character adherence (v2).flip_margin.qwen3.8-flash} points against the {aspects.character adherence (v2).margin|int}-point margin; that is the weakest margin ({weakest.arm}), and the corrected interval, a stricter view, reaches {weakest.value|pts} points. This run contradicts the earlier finding that {arm:qwen3.8-flash} lowers production cost: here it costs {cost.uplift.qwen3.8-flash} more, at a routing the snapshot does not record. If that finding holds under another routing, {arm:qwen3.8-flash} becomes the pick under today's margin despite its clear drop.

Keep {arm:September} now. Before re-pricing the candidates with routing recorded, the persona owner decides whether the {aspects.character adherence (v2).margin|int}-point margin stands, since it alone lets a cheaper {arm:qwen3.8-flash} through.

claims.text: At this run's unrecorded provider routing, both candidates cost more per reply than {arm:September}: {arm:qwen3.8-flash} by {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.production_replicating_cost.delta|abs|usd_per_1k} and {arm:1017} by {contrast.1017.production_replicating_cost.delta|abs|usd_per_1k}, each interval clear of zero, and the order holds even with {arm:September}'s unreported trials filled at its own p95 and the candidates' at zero.

evidence.caption: Paired production-cost gap against {arm:September}, corrected intervals, over trials where both arms reported cost; each arm's mean in the options summary ({cost.uplift.qwen3.8-flash} and {cost.uplift.1017} above {arm:September}) is read over that arm's own reported trials, so the two do not match exactly. The paired intervals may be too narrow if they count trials nested in conversations. Unreported cost: {cost.unreported.September.missing|int} trials for {arm:September}, {cost.unreported.qwen3.8-flash.missing|int} for {arm:qwen3.8-flash}, {cost.unreported.1017.missing|int} for {arm:1017}; {arm:September} at {cost.unreported.September.at_p95|usd_per_1k} with each at its own p95 still undercuts {arm:qwen3.8-flash} at {cost.unreported.qwen3.8-flash.free|usd_per_1k} and {arm:1017} at {cost.unreported.1017.free|usd_per_1k} with each free. {arm:1017} spent {reasoning_ratio.1017} of its output reasoning against {reasoning_ratio.September} for {arm:September}, so part of its gap may belong to reasoning, not the model.

claims.text: Neither candidate keeps Kairo in character better, and both stay inside the {aspects.character adherence (v2).margin|int}-point margin: {arm:qwen3.8-flash} passes {aspects.character adherence (v2).reading.qwen3.8-flash.change|abs|pts} points less often than {arm:September}, clearly worse but allowed, and {arm:1017} is {aspects.character adherence (v2).reading.1017.change|abs|pts} points down, not told apart from it.

evidence.caption: Change in the character pass rate against {arm:September}, with the declared margin. {arm:qwen3.8-flash} lost {scoreboard.qwen3.8-flash.lost|words} trials to harness failures, too few to move a gap this size. {arm:1017}'s different reasoning share could move its reading either way.

claims.text: On persona holds character, the judge puts both candidates behind {arm:September} at the corrected level, {arm:qwen3.8-flash} by {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.persona.holds_character.delta|abs|pts} points and {arm:1017} by {contrast.1017.persona.holds_character.delta|abs|pts}, so {arm:1017}'s unseparated pass rate is not parity.

evidence.caption: Change against {arm:September} on the pass rate and two judged dimensions, corrected together; the judge is uncalibrated.

claims.text: Off-lane asks are where both candidates fall furthest behind on persona holds character, {arm:qwen3.8-flash} at {strata.off_lane.qwen3.8-flash.persona.holds_character.mean} and {arm:1017} at {strata.off_lane.1017.persona.holds_character.mean}, and where {arm:September} itself is weakest of the six largest strata, at {strata.off_lane.September.persona.holds_character.mean}.

evidence.caption: Persona holds character by arm in the six largest strata, as the uncalibrated judge scored it; descriptive and uncorrected. Off lane, the gap to {arm:September} reads {compare.qwen3.8-flash.September.persona.holds_character.strata.off_lane.interval|interval} points for {arm:qwen3.8-flash} and {compare.1017.September.persona.holds_character.strata.off_lane.interval|interval} for {arm:1017}; these intervals are unpaired and uncorrected, and may be too narrow because repeats of one case are not independent.

claims.text: All three models slip on off-lane asks, each its own way: the {arm:1017} card narrates the listener in the third person, the {arm:qwen3.8-flash} card does the out-of-lane task it was asked, and the {arm:September} card falls into a customer-service refusal.

evidence.caption: One kept off-lane failure per arm, of {count.failures.character adherence (v2).September.off_lane|int} for {arm:September}, {count.failures.character adherence (v2).qwen3.8-flash.off_lane|int} for {arm:qwen3.8-flash} and {count.failures.character adherence (v2).1017.off_lane|int} for {arm:1017}; they show the kinds of slip, not their shares.

explore.control: The margin on the character pass rate
explore.binds: Whether a candidate counts as no worse than {arm:September}
explore.outcome: The keep holds at every margin from zero up while both candidates cost more; {arm:1017}'s reading changes at {aspects.character adherence (v2).flip_margin.1017} points and {arm:qwen3.8-flash}'s at {aspects.character adherence (v2).flip_margin.qwen3.8-flash}. A margin tighter than those would rule a candidate out on character even if it became cheaper.

omitted.why: Neither candidate is separated from the control on either, so they do not bear on the keep.

omitted.what: The ordinal outcome and transcript judged scores
omitted.why: Further views of the same conversations from the same uncalibrated judge: {arm:qwen3.8-flash} is lower on both, {arm:1017} is not separated on either, which changes nothing in the call.
The cost of running the evaluation itself, not of serving Kairo; production cost is the serving cost the call weighs.

omitted.what: Strata smaller than the six shown (emotional, lineage, next up, assistant shape and the rest)
omitted.why: Too few cases each to read; their gaps carry intervals that cross zero. The full tables hold them.

omitted.what: Per-stratum gap bars with intervals for each candidate
omitted.why: The strata table carries the rates the claim turns on, and the off-lane intervals are stated in its caption; the other strata's gaps cross zero.

omitted.what: Items delivered, tool provider faults and turns that ran over budget
omitted.why: Describe the run's mechanics and do not bear on the call.
Read while other runs executed beside it, so it is not comparable between arms.

next.text: The persona owner declares whether the {aspects.character adherence (v2).margin|int}-point margin on the character pass rate stands for the next round.
next.settles: Whether a cheaper {arm:qwen3.8-flash} would be acceptable despite its clear drop; today's margin lets it through, a margin under {aspects.character adherence (v2).flip_margin.qwen3.8-flash} points would not.

next.text: Re-price {arm:qwen3.8-flash} and {arm:1017} with each arm's provider routing recorded, and reconcile with the earlier round's cost finding.
next.settles: Whether the cost uplift belongs to the routing or the models; a candidate cheaper than {arm:September} under the declared margin would become the pick.

next.text: Calibrate the judge against human ratings of character, drawing heavily on off-lane conversations.
next.settles: Whether the persona holds character gaps and the off-lane weakness are real or the judge's taste; it turns the judge caveat into evidence either way.

next.text: Write an off-lane directive for {arm:September} and rerun the off-lane stratum.
next.settles: Whether the large stratum where every model loses most can lift on the model being kept.

next.text: Only if {arm:1017} stays of interest: rerun it at a reasoning share matched to {arm:September}'s with {settle.passed.character adherence (v2).1017.September.cases_needed_80|int} cases per arm.
next.settles: Whether its pass-rate drop of {settle.passed.character adherence (v2).1017.September.difference|abs|pts} points is real and belongs to the model, four times in five.

method.text: {cases} conversations, each run {repeats} times per arm on the character adherence (v2) aspect, run on {meta.run_date}.
A trial passes the character check as the campaign scored it; the snapshot names no grader for the aspect, so what makes a pass is not stated beyond its count of trials passed over usable.

Readings against the control, and the margin test, are at {aspects.character adherence (v2).reading.qwen3.8-flash.level}. Contrasts are paired and corrected together by Holm's method over a family of {family.family_size}, each at {family.level}. Strata gaps are unpaired and uncorrected; where trials nest within conversations some intervals may be too narrow.
Judged dimensions are scored by {judged.persona.holds_character.model}, uncalibrated, with {judged.persona.holds_character.calibration_ratings|int} human ratings.

Production cost per 1,000 replies, as each arm was served in this run; no provider is recorded for any arm and no monthly volume is declared, so no monthly figure is stated. Arm means are read over each arm's reported trials; the gaps are paired contrasts.
The aspect, control, margin and floor were all set on {late_criteria.set_at}, after the results.
The simulated user's request settings were not recorded on every run, so whether they varied cannot be established.
Latency was read under concurrent execution and is left out; input tokens, output tokens and model-call counts were not reported.
